description:
Compile-time annotation processor that generates a Propagating
    wrapper for each @PropagateToken-annotated concrete class /
    interface. The generated wrapper binds the
    PropagateTokenAdvisor-resolved HeaderValue into
    OutboundHeaderContext around every annotated method.

    Runtime sibling: PropagatingProxy.wrap(...) in jCustos-propagation
    for the JDK Dynamic Proxy path on interfaces.
